They’re offering anesthesia free dental scaling and advertising it. Groomers or even licensed vet techs do not have the scope of knowledge to perform a medical procedure on a dog on their own safely, let alone while the animal is awake and most likely in pain. This is a procedure!!! Not teeth brushing!!! They have no way to care for your dog in house if anything goes wrong. Groomers are not medical professionals, do not trust these people with your baby’s health. Go to a licensed Veterinarian. If they don’t have Dr. or DVM surrounding their name they are not equipped to scale teeth.
